headline: You may be interested / Fiscal Register for corporate income tax payers has been published in the Official Gazette
summary: New rules on the fiscal records register for obligated corporate income tax payers have been published in the Official Gazette.
why: Fiscal registers are the record-keeping systems tax authorities use to monitor company transactions, so changes affect compliance costs for businesses.
